### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A14, A15 and A20 each occurred in about 35%, 30% and 35% of traces respectively, never together, and each was followed by A21. In the later window, none of these three activities occurs in any trace. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003]
- In the earlier window, A36 was followed by A20, A15 or A14 (about 35%, 30%, 35% of its outgoing transitions) and A21 occurred two positions after A36. In the later window, A36 is followed by A21 in all observed transitions and A21 occurs one position after A36. [DIR004, LAG001]
- In the earlier window, A14, A15 and A20 each co-occurred with A21 and A26 in about 30–35% of traces, always before them, and A36 occurred before them. In the later window, A21 and A26 occur alone (without those activities) in all traces. [REL004, REL005, REL006, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL013, REL014, REL015]
- A19: in the earlier window it co-occurred with A14/A15/A20 in about 15–17% of traces and appeared alone in about 18–33%; in the later window it appears alone in about 56% of traces and never with those activities. [REL002, REL007, REL012]
- Slight position shifts: A21 moved slightly earlier (mean position from about 0.387 to 0.369) and A36 slightly later (from about 0.316 to 0.333). [POS004, POS005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the process changed by removing the alternative activities A14, A15 and A20 that used to be executed between A36 and A21 (and A26). In the later window, A36 leads directly to A21, and A14/A15/A20 no longer appear. This is supported by the complete disappearance of these activities, the change in A36's outgoing transitions from A14/A15/A20 to A21, and the lag between A36 and A21 shrinking from two positions to one. The evidence is strong (28 items vs 0.41 expected by chance). A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that A14/A15/A20 are still possible but were not observed in the later sample; however, the direct A36→A21 path and the lag change make removal the most plausible interpretation.

Other differences: A19 no longer co-occurs with the removed activities and appears alone more often; slight position shifts of A21 and A36 are consistent with the removal but are not part of the main hypothesis.
